prompt:
Use the attached1672x941 six-panel template directly. Preserve exact dark navy header/grid/borders/floor/margins/badges01–06. Create SIX FRIENDLY SOFTWARE REQUIREMENTS ANALYST tower character concepts, each wearing a DIFFERENT SMALL FITTED HAT. The Analyst gathers requirements, facilitates discovery and refines user stories. This is wearable design exploration, not giant icons or diagram props.
COMMON CHARACTER FAMILY all six: compact low-poly rounded pale teal robot HEAD ONLY, clean navy face display with two simple cyan vertical capsule eyes, chalk face lip and small deep teal/chalk ear pods. No limbs, torso, stand, floating objects. Same head proportions, simple pleasant expression, forward facing, hats sit naturally snugly against crown. Hats modestly sized: hat width about95–110% head width; hat height only20–30% head height (beanie35% maximum). Accessories subordinate to head, not giant billboards. No oversized checklists, cards, speech bubbles, diagrams, crowns, nodes, goggles, glasses, lenses, monocles or pointed brows. NO large pictograms/icons at all. Communicate analyst role with material/accessory character: a SMALL tucked stylus, little bookmark/tab, stitched paper-like seam. Low-poly game-feasible below2500triangles, broad clean opaque colour blocks, slight bevels, no noisy texture.
Six directions:
01 STORY EDITOR: fitted chalk/soft teal classic FLAT CAP, shallow slightly sloped crown and short rounded forward lip high ABOVE eyes. One little deep teal pencil tucked alongside the ear, pencil height only40% headheight. Quiet thoughtful editor.
02 DISCOVERY BERET: small deep teal soft BERET, shallow rounded disk, tilted slightly, soft chalk fitted band. Tiny folded bookmark tab tucked into side band, no badges or giant icons. Approachable facilitator.
03 WORKSHOP FOLD: snug low folded PAPER CAP, chalk surface with pale teal panels, simple central crease and two softly beveled upward sloped folds. NOT huge newspaper/hat like billboard; cap height25%headheight, folded brim wraps crown, no writing. Small teal tab at one side.
04 SCOPE BUCKET: compact pale teal BUCKET HAT with low rounded tapered crown and narrow soft chalk downward brim sitting at top edge well ABOVE eyes. A short dark teal band with two small sewn bookmark ends, no chart or badge. Calm practical analyst.
05 REFINEMENT KNIT: short snug teal BEANIE with a broad chalk turned-up cuff, no tall cone, no pompom, simple lowpoly softened crown with3–4 large rib seams only. A single tiny rectangular teal story-tab clip on cuff. Friendly approachable thinking.
06 SESSION CAP: low soft chalk/teal BASEBALL CAP with a modest rounded front brim angled slightly upward so forehead/eyes clear; cap fits snugly and has simple large crown panels and one teal seam. A small chalk pencil clipped at SIDE band, subordinate. Collaborative workshop lead.
STRICT FRONT orthographic view, no threequarter or dramatic tilted camera, consistent head size and groundbaseline. All models feel like characters wearing clothes, not mascot icons enlarged onheads. Same neutral studio lighting. Pale teal housing #91D9D2, chalk #E2EDF0, deeper teal #398D94, navy #041D2A, cyan eyes. Add no fancy glow.
CRITICAL LAYOUT: each head assembly about230px wide and190–220px tall inside its panel; top characters occupy y185–390, groundbaseliney390; bottom y580–785, baseliney785. All shadows endbyy400/795. Fully clear bottom labelzones y410–482 and805–879; no artwork overlaps badges or text. Generous negative space. Header can retain placeholders and ALL bottomname/descriptionzones blank; exactlabels addedlater. Noextraelements, footer, arrows, measurements, environment, turnarounds or technical text. Six compact differentiated hats are the only major designvariation.
